description: This file defines the 'Code2of5Interleaved' class implementing the Code 2 of 5 barcode generation, including rendering logic, size calculations, and code validation within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: Code2of5Interleaved
classes.description: Implementation of the Code 2 of 5 interleaved barcode, providing rendering, validation, and size calculation functionalities.

methods.name: ThickAndThinLines
methods.description: Returns an array representing the pattern of thick (true) and thin (false) lines for a given digit.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders the barcode using the given graphics context, handling start, stop, and each digit pair rendering.

methods.name: CalcThinBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of thin bars based on the total size and text length.

methods.name: RenderStart
methods.description: Renders the start sequence of the barcode.

methods.name: RenderStop
methods.description: Renders the stop sequence of the barcode.

methods.name: RenderNextPair
methods.description: Renders the next pair of digits as a sequence of bars and gaps.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Validates that the input code is suitable for interleaved 2 of 5 barcode (numeric and even length).
